_readme: Short links: leadfuse.co/book/<slug> forwards to the APPLICATION for that place (leadfuse.co/apply/<apply>/), never to a calendar. Everyone fills out the application first so they get graded before they can book (reds never reach the green calendar). Sebastian, Nov 25 2026: 'Nobody should ever be sent to a calendar.' The query on the clicked link is kept. Add a row, run build.py, commit. Never rename a slug that has been sent to someone.
